notes.title: demo bug fixes patch - 0.3.19
notes.content:
0.3.19

Adjustment : 
	- slightly increase Crystal fish energy on last phase

Bug fixes :
- added out of bound safety.
- fixed being able to pause while transition to new scene
- fixed collision problem for scene transition


0.3.18
- fix perfect tension not showing when skipping tutorial

notes.title: demo bug fixes patch - 0.3.17
notes.content:
0.3.17

Cloud save is now avaliable

Adjustments :
	- baiting is required to input to the beat,you can no longer just spam input.
	- fish energy depletion can increase if you are more precise to the beat, damage can decrease for being too offbeat too.
	- skipping rank notice will no longer close right away.
	- Added sound effect for perfect tension.
	- Added multiple slider for sound effect option.
	- the default slider value to audio will be at 70 % instead, except slider for sound that tied to other slider.
	- Due to Several game breaking bugs identified caused by an Audio offset, the option to set Audio offset will be temporarily disabled, and Audio offset will be set to 0.0 by default

Bug fixes :
- fixed some collision issue of environment in some area
- fixed bug where you can get stuck in spacial item option notice
- fixed issue where the holding and swinging fishing rod don't play sound effect.

0.3.16
- fixed rank not count correctly
